Interval.Name: How often to measure latency (seconds)
Interval.Hint: Default: 20. Lower = more measurements; higher = less traffic. Leave as is if unsure.

Hide.Name: Hide latency in the player list

Micro.Name: Compact mode (+ / - instead of ms value)

DiagTooltip.Name: Show jitter and estimated loss in tooltip
DiagTooltip.Hint: When disabled, the tooltip only shows the ms value.

AbyssTheme.Name: Abyss Link theme (dark manhwa)
AbyssTheme.Hint: Enables the dark/neon visual layer for Connection Guard badges, banners and panels.

AutoReconnect.Name: More aggressive auto-reconnect
AutoReconnect.Hint: Shortens the delay between reconnection attempts and forces a new attempt as soon as the network or tab become active again.

ReconnectMaxDelay.Name: Max wait between reconnect attempts (seconds)
ReconnectMaxDelay.Hint: Default: 15. Leave as is if unsure.

HistorySize.Name: How many drops to keep in history
HistorySize.Hint: Default: 30. How many recent drops the GM panel keeps.

DegradationThreshold.Name: Latency that triggers a warning (ms)
DegradationThreshold.Hint: Default: 300. Above this for several cycles, the module warns before the drop.

DegradationCycles.Name: Warnings in a row before alerting
DegradationCycles.Hint: Default: 3. How many measurements above the limit before warning.

RouteProfiles.Name: Abyss Link extra routes
RouteProfiles.Hint: Optional. Paste one route per line or comma-separated. Example: softmisst.playit.plus:1051, 192.168.0.10:30000, 26.0.0.10:30000. The module always includes the current route automatically.

RouteScanTimeout.Name: Max time per route test (ms)
RouteScanTimeout.Hint: Default: 2500. Leave as is if unsure.

FailoverTimeout.Name: Wait before Plan B (Radmin) (seconds)
FailoverTimeout.Hint: Default: 30. If the main connection drops, how long to wait before sending players to Radmin.

GmPanel.Name: Diagnostics Panel (GM)
GmPanel.Label: Open panel
GmPanel.Hint: Latency, jitter, estimated loss, drop history, degradation alerts and route matrix.

RouteOracle.Name: Abyss Link Route Oracle
RouteOracle.Label: Scan routes
RouteOracle.Hint: Compares GM-configured routes and recommends the best path for each player.

ServiceWizard.Name: Connection assistant
ServiceWizard.Label: Configure service
ServiceWizard.Hint: Choose the service used by the GM and configure only the selected route.

Advanced.Name: Advanced (network)
Advanced.Label: Open advanced settings
Advanced.Hint: Technical intervals and timings. Leave as is if unsure.

Menu.DependenciesNotReady: Connection Guard is not ready yet. Try again after the scene finishes loading.

Advanced.Title: Advanced settings
Advanced.Intro: These options are technical; the defaults work for most tables. Change only if you know what you're doing.
Advanced.SaveFailed: Could not save. Check the console and try again.
Advanced.GmOnly: Only the GM can open advanced settings.

ServiceWizard.Title: Connect your friends
ServiceWizard.Intro: Fill in the address your players use to connect. It is saved for the table.
ServiceWizard.ChoiceQuestion: How do your friends get into your table?
ServiceWizard.ChoiceHint: Not sure which one? If your friends install a program, it is Radmin. If you send them a link or address, it is playit/ngrok/Cloudflare. If everyone is at your house or on the same network, it is the local network.

Choice.radmin: They install Radmin VPN and join my group
Choice.playit: They open a link like xxxx.playit.gg
Choice.ngrok: They open a temporary address I generate (ngrok)
Choice.cloudflare: They open a fixed Cloudflare address
Choice.local: They are at the same house or network as me
Choice.direct: I give them my IP address

ServiceWizard.NoWebRtc: This module configures only the Foundry route. Discord voice does not need STUN/TURN.
ServiceWizard.Endpoint: Address you send to your friends
ServiceWizard.Invalid: Check the selected service, address, and port.
ServiceWizard.RedundancyHint: If the main connection drops, players can be sent to this Radmin address. Optional leave it off if you do not use Radmin.
ServiceWizard.InvalidRadmin: Invalid Radmin IP or port. Fallback was not enabled.
ServiceWizard.ReadinessWarning: Automatic failover requires each client to have network access to the configured Radmin VPN host. Connection Guard cannot configure Radmin VPN or operating-system firewall rules automatically.
ServiceWizard.ReadinessCheck2: Host connected to the Radmin network
ServiceWizard.ReadinessCheck3: Players connected to the same Radmin network
ServiceWizard.ReadinessCheck4: Foundry port open on the firewall
ServiceWizard.ReadinessCheck5: Radmin route tested by at least one client
ServiceWizard.CopyFailed: Could not copy the firewall command.

Requirements.radmin: Everyone must join the same Radmin network and allow the Foundry port through the firewall.
Requirements.playit: The playit.gg agent must be running on the GM's computer.
Requirements.ngrok: The ngrok agent must be running; the free plan address may change.
Requirements.cloudflare: cloudflared must be running on the GM's computer.
Requirements.local: Everyone must be on the same local network as the GM.
Requirements.direct: The port must be forwarded and allowed through the GM's firewall.
Requirements.custom: Confirm the custom address is reachable by the players.

Note.Radmin: Radmin VPN Free: every player must install Radmin and join the GM's network.

Badge.NoResponseTitle: No response for several measurement cycles

Banner.Disconnected: Lost connection to the server ({reason}). Trying to reconnect...

Notif.Reconnected: Reconnected to the server (was down for {seconds}s).

Panel.JournalError: Error creating journal. Check the console.

Verdict.AllGoodHint: No connection problem detected right now.
Verdict.AttentionHint: Some players have an unstable connection.
Verdict.ProblemHint: One or more players are not responding.

Action.Reload: Ask the unresponsive player to reload the page (F5).
Action.TestRoutes: Open the Connection assistant and scan the routes to compare.

Route.SelectServiceFirst: First choose the service used by the GM in the Connection assistant.
Route.NoProfilesHelp: The GM has not selected a service yet. Open Configure service and save the active route.
Route.ScanActiveStarted: Testing only the active route selected by the GM.
Route.Label: Route
Route.LimitNote: Note: the module tests only the route selected by the GM. It does not change VPN, firewall, DNS or OS routing.
Route.MatrixEmpty: No player has run the Route Oracle this session.

Hint.MixedContent: The browser may have blocked HTTP from an HTTPS page.
Hint.Timeout: Timed out. The route may be blocked, offline, or unreachable from this client.

Service.ActiveNone: No active route set. Scan the routes and choose which service the table should use.
Service.SelectedNotif: The GM set the table's route: {label} click the chip on the edge of the screen to connect.
Service.ReloadHint: Open the link and reload Foundry to change route.
Service.GmOnly: Only the GM can set the table's active route.

Hint.Local: Local route: the Foundry host must be reachable on the same LAN.
Hint.Radmin: Radmin VPN: everyone needs Radmin VPN installed, connected, and in the same group. The 26.x.x.x range only answers inside the VPN.
Hint.Cloudflare: Cloudflare Tunnel: cloudflared must be running on the Foundry host with the hostname configured.
Hint.Playit: playit.gg: the tunnel must be active on the host with the port forwarded. Check the playit panel.
Hint.Ngrok: ngrok: the agent must be running on the host. On the free plan the URL changes on every restart prefer a static domain.
Hint.Direct: Direct IP: the public IP must be reachable and the port open on the firewall/router.
Hint.Custom: Custom route: check that the endpoint is up and reachable from your network.

Gate.GmOnly: Only the GM can open or close the table's connection.
Gate.ClosedHint: The GM has closed the connection to this table. Wait for it to reopen to enter again.
Gate.LockedNotif: Connection closed. Players can no longer enter.
Gate.UnlockedNotif: Connection open. Players may enter again.
Gate.ConfirmLockContent: Players (non-GM) will be banned with role NONE and anyone connected will be ejected. GM and Assistants are not affected. The server stays up; only player logins will be rejected.
Gate.ConfirmUnlockContent: Saved permissions will be restored and players may enter again.
Gate.ToggleFailed: The operation did not finish. The padlock shows the real state try again.

Journal.ExportIntro: Entries in memory this session: {count}. Nothing is saved automatically; choose Markdown, JSON, or Journal Entry.
